messages:
Rina: Quick heads-up 1: Han from VendorZ just flagged a container allocation shortage at the LA port. Our 6-rack order might be split across two vessels, earliest consolidated ETA now 2025-08-04 (was 2025-07-22).
Tom: Oof. Does this affect serial/firmware batches?
Han-VendorZ: Vendor: Correct, the split means 2 racks come from batch B (firmware v2.1), 4 racks from batch A (v2.0). Batch B needs a minor firmware reflash to meet our compatibility. We can flash at factory if you approve.
Jorge: Flashing at factory ok, but will add ~48h and a $450 per-rack handling fee. Air freight one rack to meet SI pilot?
Linh: For marketplace QA we need 2 racks in staging for HA tests. Can we get 2 by air and the rest by sea?
Han-VendorZ: Airlift estimate: $6k per rack door-to-door; factory flash + 48h included if requested. Sea remains cheapest but delayed.
Rina: Options: (1) Accept later consolidated sea arrival (no extra spend), (2) Flash & split with 2 racks airlift for SI pilot + 4 by sea, (3) Wait but ask vendor to prioritize only racks with v2.0 (might be possible). Thoughts?
Tom: Product prefers (2) to keep pilot on schedule. If Finance ok with delta.
Finance-Bot: Auto: Any spend > $5k requires manager approval. Estimated delta for 2-rack airlift = $12k, plus vendor handling = $900. Requesting @Maya approval to tap partnership co-op.
Rina: @Maya please advise. Also need legal signoff for air export docs (EAR/ITAR check) if air moves faster.
Maya: I'll review. Prefers (2) if co-op covers. Legal, please confirm export controls for the SKU.
Rina: Han, can you publish a new manifest with batch mapping and HS codes + invoice so customs/broker can pre-clear if we airlift?
Han-VendorZ: Will upload updated manifest and HS list within 3h. Also can flag which serials will be airlifted.
Jorge: Implementation note: if we get 2 racks early, SI can start integration tests but we must gate public marketplace provisioning until all racks pass QA. Platform can toggle listing to "partner preview".
Linh: I'll sync with Platform to create a partner-preview flag and make sure no provisioning or billing occurs.
Tom: Also confirm remote access keys & license tokens will be valid for the airlift racks. Licensing team needs serials early.
Rina: I'll request serial list and license tokens once manifest posted.
manifest-bot: Manifest update pending: PO 992112 will have 2 serials flagged for AIRSHIP. Link: https://vendorz.manifests/992112 (restricted)
Han-VendorZ: Snippet of updated manifest:
```
SKU: RACK-MINI-4GPU
Qty total: 6
Airlift Qty: 2
Serials air: VZ-A1001,VZ-A1002
Batch mapping: A -> v2.0 (serials VZ-A1003..A1006), B -> v2.1 (serials VZ-B2001..B2002)
HS codes: 8471.80.10
```
Tom: Good. @Legal please confirm any export red flags for airlift. @Maya please confirm if co-op covers ~$13k delta.
Maya: I'll escalate to Finance and Legal now. If approved, proceed with airlift & factory flash for the two racks.
Finance-Bot: Noted. Finance review required. Tagging @Carter for approval.
Rina: Action list: 1) Han to upload final manifest + invoice (3h). 2) Maya to get Finance + Legal thumbs. 3) Linh to set partner-preview listing. 4) Jorge to prepare SI pilot scoping for 2 racks. 5) Tom to coordinate license token mapping. Keep all updates here.
Tom: One more: flash at factory means we skip onsite reflash, saves rack downtime. Please confirm AMI/firmware checksum before we boot.
Han-VendorZ: Will include firmware checksums in manifest.
Rina: Thanks everyone. Will update when Finance or manifest arrives. :eyes:
